executionArgs.additionalInstruction: CRITICAL: All POST /api/users, PUT /api/users/:id, and PATCH /api/users/:id/status responses wrap the user object in a 'user' key. Example: POST /api/users returns {"user": {"id": 5, "username": "alice", ...}}. Always extract the id as resp.json()["user"]["id"] — never as resp.json()["id"]. Same for update and status patch responses. Also generate tests for Phase 2 endpoints: GET /api/vendors, POST /api/vendors/import/preview (multipart CSV), POST /api/vendors/import (JSON), GET /api/items, POST /api/items/import/preview, POST /api/items/import, POST /api/transactions/receipts, GET /api/transactions/stock-position, GET /api/transactions, GET /api/dashboard/stats, GET /api/dashboard/low-stock, GET /api/dashboard/dead-stock, GET /api/dashboard/valuation, GET /api/dashboard/activity. For receipt tests create a vendor and item first via the import endpoints. All endpoints require Bearer token from admin login (jose / password123).
